A '''skirmish''' took place at [[Moxonnic Manufacturing]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] between misguided [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Ring-Sol Ambase]] and his [[Star Wars: Jedi Apprentice|Jedi Apprentice]] [[Nuru Kungurama]].<ref name="Guardians">''[[The Clone Wars: Secret Missions 4: Guardians of the Chiss Key]]''</ref>

{{Battle-stub}}
